steps.text: Season 600-750 g rolled beef brisket generously with salt and black pepper.
Add 20 g vegetable oil to the mixing bowl. Use Browning mode to brown the 600-750 g brisket on several sides, turning it carefully as needed. Remove the beef and set aside.
Add 2 quartered onions, 2 roughly chopped carrots and 2 garlic cloves. Chop 5 sec / speed 5.
Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl, then cook 8 min / 120°C / speed 1.
Add 25 g tomato purée and cook 3 min / 120°C / speed 1.
Add 150 g red wine, 450 g beef stock, 20 g Worcestershire sauce, 1 tsp Marmite, 1 tsp dried thyme and 1 bay leaf.
Return the browned 600-750 g brisket to the mixing bowl.
Cook using Slow Cook mode / 95°C / 4 hours.
Check the beef. A knife or skewer should slide in very easily. If it still feels firm, cook using Slow Cook mode / 95°C for a further 30 minutes.
Carefully remove the brisket and cover loosely with foil. Remove and discard the 1 bay leaf.
Blend the cooking liquid 30 sec / speed 8.
In a small bowl, mix 20-25 g cornflour with 30 g cold water until completely smooth, then add it to the mixing bowl.
Taste the gravy and adjust with a little extra Marmite, salt or black pepper if needed.
For a richer, glossy finish, add 15 g butter if using and mix 20 sec / speed 3.
Slice or gently pull apart the brisket and serve with plenty of the gravy.
